_note: WIRE format (camelCase, null fields omitted) - what the C# layer emits and adapters/claude reads. Two fields keep a snake_case name by explicit [JsonProperty]: last_known_state_version, result_geometry. tests/test_wire_contract.py diffs this file against Models/ExecutionResponse.cs and CadState.cs.

COMPLETED.verified: boolean (false when the tool succeeded but a feature it just made is reported in error: see diagnostics)
COMPLETED.result_geometry: object|null - read-back of the real geometry a create tool produced (tool specific)
COMPLETED.diagnostics: object|null - post-tool health read-back for feature-mutating tools: {feature_errors_total, new_feature_errors:[{feature,type,code,error,warning}], whats_wrong, volume_m3, volume_delta_m3}
